description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the 'history' module, including help text, cron jobs, node and comment view alterations, and entity deletion handlers.

classes.name: HistoryHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks for the history module, managing help display, cron cleanup, node and comment view alterations, and entity deletions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the HistoryHooks class, injecting the current user account.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information about the history module for specific routes.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs cleanup of old history records during cron runs.

methods.name: nodeViewAlter
methods.description: Alters node view builds to add data attributes, attach libraries, and mark nodes as read.

methods.name: nodeDelete
methods.description: Deletes history records associated with a node when the node is deleted.

methods.name: userCancel
methods.description: Deletes history records when a user cancels their account reassignments.

methods.name: userDelete
methods.description: Deletes history records when a user account is deleted.

methods.name: commentView
methods.description: Attaches comment indicators and metadata for comment entities viewed by authenticated users.
